claims.quote: The leucine zipper-like transcriptional regulator 1 (LZTR1) protein, an adaptor for cullin 3 (CUL3) ubiquitin ligase complex, is implicated in human disease, yet its mechanism of action remains unknown.
Ubiquitome analysis showed that loss of Lztr1 abrogated Ras ubiquitination at lysine-170.
LZTR1-mediated ubiquitination inhibited RAS signaling by attenuating its association with the membrane.

We found that Lztr1 haploinsufficiency in mice recapitulates Noonan syndrome phenotypes, whereas LZTR1 loss in Schwann cells drives dedifferentiation and proliferation.
